case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
title: Night ride, a 60 s single take

turns.text: Make a 60-second single continuous take, widescreen, live action: a bicycle courier in a yellow rain jacket rides through a rainy city at night. It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends as she stops at the lit door of a small café and steps off the bike. No cuts and no camera jumps: the same rider, the same jacket, the same bike, the same rain and the same night light from the first second to the last. Ambient sound only: rain, tyres, the city. No music, no speech, no text on screen.

tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

answer_sheet.Rider: a woman in a yellow rain jacket on an ordinary city bike; the rest is your call
answer_sheet.City: any rainy city at night; your call
answer_sheet.Sound: ambient only: rain, tyres, the city; no music, no speech

must_haves: One continuous take: no visible cut, jump or change of scene anywhere, including at the midpoint.
The same rider in the same yellow rain jacket on the same bike from the first second to the last.
It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends with her stopping at the lit door of a small café and stepping off the bike.
Rain and night throughout, with consistent light.
Ambient sound only: no music, no speech, no text on screen.
